legal_and_tax_checks.source_title: Agencia Tributaria – Alquilo un apartamento turístico ¿tengo que ingresar IVA?
legal_and_tax_checks.finding: The authority distinguishes accommodation with hotel-type services (10% VAT) from rentals without such services (VAT-exempt). A stay longer than 31 nights alone is not a blanket VAT-exemption test. Entry/exit cleaning alone is not treated as a hotel-type service in this guidance.
